### 2. COURSE-LEVEL `properties.yaml`

Notable fields:

- `auth` -- authentication level (0 = none)
- `labStepsAutoNumber` -- whether lab steps are auto-numbered
- `llm` -- LLM integration level
- `ignorepin` -- PIN code to reveal hidden topics

- `parent` -- parent course reference

### 3. TOPIC FOLDER STRUCTURE

Each topic folder contains:

```
topic-NN-slug/
  topic.md          # Topic title and description (OR a custom name like typical.md)
  topic.png         # Topic card image (optional if using Iconify icons)
  unit-1/           # Units group learning objects
  unit-2/
  side-unit/        # Optional sidebar unit (holds labs shown in a sidebar)
  panelvideo-1/     # Panel video (appears at topic level)
  panelnote/        # Panel note (appears at topic level)
  paneltalk/        # Panel talk (appears at topic level)
```

The `topic.md` file is typically just a title and one line of description:

```
# Simple

Units with presentations, labs + resources
```

Alternatively, `topic.md` can use YAML frontmatter for an Iconify icon instead of a PNG image:

```markdown
---
icon:
  type: emojione:owl
---
# Iconify

Using Iconify defined icons instead of image files
```

IMPORTANT naming convention: In `topic-01-typical`, the topic markdown is named `typical.md` (not `topic.md`) and the image is `typical.png`. In all other topics it is `topic.md` / `topic.png`. ### 4. UNIT FOLDER STRUCTURE

```

  main-lesson.md       # Unit title (single line of text, no heading)
  talk-1-intro/        # Talk folders (presentations)
  talk-2-explore/
  book-a/              # Book/lab folders
  notebook-a/          # Jupyter notebook folders
  note-1/              # Note folders
